components.description: Storybook-only Foundations grid. Enumerates the design-system color custom properties actually loaded in the preview (.storybook/design-tokens.scss), resolves each value, groups them, and copies var(--name) on click. mode="semantic" also exposes a light/dark toggle (tokens differ per theme).

properties actually loaded in the preview (`.storybook/design-tokens.scss`),

`mode="semantic"` also exposes a light/dark toggle (tokens differ per theme).
